name: sol_basics_vi_svi_10
description: ABI-reencoding of nested calldata arrays reads beyond calldatasize() due to missing size check
question: The source file in `source` uses a Solidity compiler version between 0.5.8 and 0.8.13 (inclusive) and contains a function that ABI-encodes or passes a nested dynamic calldata array (e.g., array of dynamic arrays or array of structs containing dynamic arrays) directly to an external call or abi.encode/abi.encodeWithSelector, without upgrading to a patched compiler version (>=0.8.14) or otherwise avoiding re-encoding of nested calldata arrays, such that the compiler's improper size check could read memory or calldata beyond calldatasize(), potentially causing out-of-bounds reads or corrupted data. This excludes files that only handle single-dimensional dynamic arrays or that already specify a fixed compiler version >=0.8.14.
criteria: A function parameter typed as a nested calldata array (e.g., uint256[][] calldata or MyStruct[] calldata where MyStruct contains a dynamic array) is directly forwarded via abi.encode or abi.encodeCall to another contract call
An external function accepts bytes[] calldata or similar nested dynamic array and re-encodes it via abi.encodeWithSelector before making a low-level call, under pragma solidity >=0.5.8 <0.8.14
A library or internal function re-ABI-encodes a calldata array of dynamic-length structs for cross-contract calls without any compiler version guard or check against calldatasize()
